rationale: The agent authenticated the user and looked up relevant orders, but it performed multiple order-changing actions (returns and a cancellation) without first confirming with the user, violating policy. It also canceled the entire pending order #W2575533 rather than only the hose item, despite the user’s explicit instruction to cancel only the hose and to forgo cancellation if item-level cancellation wasn’t possible. This contradicts the user’s intent and the policy to confirm before writes. Therefore the request was not completed in line with policy.
